method.instrumentation: No CDP, DevTools, trace, allocation sampler, heap snapshot, forced GC or pressure commands. Existing one-time UI Automation phase checks only.
method.memory: Concurrent process-tree private bytes; arithmetic sample means and independent per-process maxima. Combined maxima are selected after summing each sample.
method.cpu: Sum cumulative CPU-counter differences per PID plus birth identity between first and last selected samples, divided by collector monotonic elapsed-time difference; percentage = cores / 24 * 100. Five stable identities checked; overall total cross-checked against collector.
method.departure: PERF_LIVE idle UTC minus PERF_LIVE busy UTC minus 610 seconds; source-derived schedule, not a separate native leave timestamp or frame/input latency.
method.responsiveness: Existing UI Automation found Realm and Nexus once in each accepted run and no persistent subscription-failure label. No input/frame latency percentile was measured.
method.windows: Half-open intervals: observed seed before busy; early 0-30; steady 30-580; late 580-610; departure busy+610 through logged idle+30; idle logged+30-175.
method.sampling: 100 ms requested during initial collector discovery, then 1000 ms plus sampling overhead; sub-sample peaks can be missed; startup before attachment is not covered.

excluded_attempts.reason: Collector inventory identity guard stopped the initial attempt before any sample. No measurement used. Fresh-profile retry retained the guard.

sources.purpose: Memory-over-speed flag definition; 1 MiB maximum semi-space implication; distinct max-old-space-size and max-heap-size flags.
Semi-space and old-generation sizing are separate; optimize_for_size also participates in initial semi-space configuration.
